hooks.command: jq -c '.tool_input as $input | {hookSpecificOutput: ({hookEventName: "PreToolUse"} + (if $input.session_id != null then {permissionDecision: "deny", permissionDecisionReason: "session_id cannot be set."} else {permissionDecision: "allow", updatedInput: ($input + {session_id: (if (.agent_id // "") != "" then "\(.session_id)/\(.agent_id)" else .session_id end)})} end))}'
